Hook sidebar

Product·by @SwamiMalode·2026-09-01·inspora page·original post

What it is

Dark 'CONTENTS' sidebar where a red dotted vertical rail bends into a right-angle hook pointing at the hovered/active item; the hook slides up/down the list with the pointer and the active label brightens.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Sidebar list (Introduction, History, Overview, Architecture, References); red dotted rail runs down the left; the rail's hook (a short horizontal dotted stub bending 90deg right) sits at 'Introduction', its label white, others grey.
15-40%
Pointer moves to History: the hook point slides down the rail to History's row; the bend re-forms at the new row with a quick elastic snap; History brightens, Introduction dims.
40-60%
Hook jumps further down through Overview to Architecture; the vertical segment above the hook stays solid-ish while below it remains sparse dots; labels update brightness.
60-85%
Hook returns upward to History, then down to References - motion is a smooth slide of the bend position, not a fade.
85-100%
Hook settles on References; loop.

Mechanics

trigger
hover / pointer over list rows
elements
dotted vertical rail, hook (L-bend) indicator, row labels
properties
hook Y position, label color/opacity
timing
hook travel 250-350ms between rows
easing
spring (stiffness ~300, damping ~26) with slight overshoot on arrival
loop
demo cycles through rows

Build prompt

Build a contents sidebar with a hook indicator. Rows: 5 text links (14px, grey #777, active white). Left of the rows, render an SVG rail: a vertical dotted line (1.5px dots, 6px pitch, red #FF3B30) spanning the list, plus a hook: the rail bends 90deg right at the active row's midline and extends ~10px toward the label. Animate the bend's Y with a spring (stiffness 300, damping 26, 250-350ms travel) whenever the hovered row changes; the dots are generated from the current path so the hook literally slides. Implementation: one <path> recomputed per frame from hookY (vertical line -> quadratic corner -> horizontal stub), stroke-dasharray '1.5 6', round caps; or pre-rendered canvas. Active label transitions color over 150ms. The playful detail: the corner radius tightens as it moves fast and relaxes on arrival (radius proportional to velocity).
